name: opl-flow
description: OPL Flow starts and supervises a durable task ledger, provides a model-native Codex profile, and coordinates optional Fleet execution.

interface.longDescription: OPL Flow creates or reuses one Beads-backed Dashboard and hourly supervisor, packages a concise Codex profile, and coordinates optional Instance-backed Fleet execution.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $opl-flow start to create or reuse my OPL ledger Dashboard and supervise it every hour.
